loc.goblin_tunnel.name: Goblin Tunnel
loc.goblin_tunnel.description: A cramped tunnel scratched out by goblin claws. It breaks through into a proper mine shaft to the west.

loc.mine_entrance.name: Mine Entrance
loc.mine_entrance.description: Timber props, rusted rails and a sign reading DAIN & SONS - KEEP OUT. A lift cage hangs over the shaft.

loc.mine_shaft.name: Main Shaft
loc.mine_shaft.description: The lift cage creaks at the top of a long wooden ladder. A goblin tunnel breaks through the east wall, and the shaft keeps going down.

loc.mine_lower.name: Lower Galleries
loc.mine_lower.description: Abandoned carts and broken picks. Small figures with lanterns scurry at the edge of the light - the kobolds have moved in.

loc.flooded_gallery.name: Flooded Gallery
loc.flooded_gallery.description: Black water up to your knees. Something jelly-like glistens on the surface.

loc.crystal_cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
loc.crystal_cavern.description: Crystals as tall as a man grow from the walls and hum faintly. Carved steps descend to a sealed dwarven door, long since forced open.

loc.dwarf_forge.name: Forge of the Deep
loc.dwarf_forge.description: An ancient dwarven forge, cold for centuries. In the middle of it stands a guardian of carved stone, a red light pulsing in its chest. Behind it, a stair drops toward a great round gate.

item.miners_lamp.name: Miner's Lamp
item.miners_lamp.description: A dented brass lamp. Swung hard, it hurts.

item.iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
item.iron_ore.description: A lump of good ore. Borga would like this.

item.crystal_shard.name: Crystal Shard
item.crystal_shard.description: A humming sliver of crystal. Holding it steadies the heart.

item.goblin_spear.name: Goblin Spear
item.goblin_spear.description: Crooked, but pointy at the right end.

item.golem_heart.name: Golem Heart
item.golem_heart.description: A fist-sized ruby, still warm, still beating very slowly.

item.runed_blade.name: Runed Blade
item.runed_blade.description: Borga's masterwork, quenched in the golem's heart. The runes glow red when it strikes.

npc.goblin_scout.name: Goblin Scout
npc.goblin_scout.description: A skinny goblin with a spear longer than itself.
dialogue: Chief will hear of this! If chief still alive...

npc.kobold.name: Kobold Miner
npc.kobold.description: Small, scaly and armed with a stolen pick.

npc.slime.name: Gallery Slime
npc.slime.description: A wobbling mass of grey jelly with a boot floating inside it.

npc.golem.name: Stone Guardian
npc.golem.description: Three times your height, carved from a single block of granite. Its ruby heart pulses as it turns toward you.

npc.foreman.name: Foreman Dain
npc.foreman.description: A dwarf with a beard tucked into his belt and soot in every wrinkle.
dialogue: Kobolds! In MY mine! Took the lower galleries while we were at lunch.
Down the lift, then down again. Mind the water to the east.
My grandfather said the old dwarves left a guardian below the crystals. Never believed him until the kobolds came running up screaming.
Below the forge there's a gate the old dwarves carved: ONLY TOGETHER. Nobody goes through it alone, and nobody should.

q.mine_trouble.title: Kobolds in the Mine
q.mine_trouble.description: Foreman Dain wants his lower galleries back.

steps.description: Go down to the lower galleries of the mine.

q.golem_heart.title: Heart of Stone
q.golem_heart.description: The Stone Guardian's ruby heart could fuel a legendary forging. Smith Borga will know what to do with it.

steps.description: Defeat the Stone Guardian in the Forge of the Deep.
Bring the Golem Heart to Smith Borga in the village.
